(Japanese: '''アカリとピカチュウのたんじょうび''' ''Akari and Pikachu's Birthday''), is the 38th and last chapter of the [[How I Became a Pokémon Card]] manga.

{{Spoilers}}

==Plot==
{{HIBAPC|Akari}} wants his first Pokémon seeing that his long-time friend {{HIBAPC|Akira}} has a Pokémon.

==Major events==
* {{HIBAPC|Akari}} receives a {{p|Pikachu}} as a present.

==Characters==
===Humans===
* {{HIBAPC|Akari}}
* {{HIBAPC|Akira}}
* Students

===Pokémon===
* {{p|Pikachu}} ({{HIBAPC|Akari}}'s)
* {{p|Scyther}} ({{HIBAPC|Akira}}'s)
* {{p|Clefairy}} (student's)
* {{p|Oddish}}
* {{p|Poliwag}}
* {{p|Pichu}}
* {{p|Ariados}} (×5)
